notes: Three things for group chats. Type an @ and the members appear above the keyboard, filtering as you type; tap one to drop the name in. Anyone you tag answers — tag three and all three answer, and nobody who wasn't tagged joins in. Press send with the box empty and instead of a character at random you get the list of who's there, so you can pick who speaks next, or leave it to the app. And renaming a group was already possible but hidden behind a menu item called Members; it now reads Name and members, and the page it opens calls itself Group settings, with the chat header updating the moment you save.
